text:
Pride and Prejudice was written by **Jane Austen**. It was first published in 1813 and remains one of the most beloved and widely read novels in English literature.

The novel follows Elizabeth Bennet, one of five sisters in a genteel but financially precarious family, as she navigates issues of manners, upbringing, morality, and marriage in rural Regency-era England. Her evolving relationship with the wealthy and seemingly aloof Mr. Darcy forms the heart of the story.
